title: GPAI Art.12 / EU AI Pact — IAW related-measures crosswalk (not compliance)

related_gspc_axes.why: Logging / record-keeping artefacts are neighbouring evidence for provenance transparency — not Art.12 compliance.
Lifetime event logs over a system lifetime neighbour continuity measurement — not a conformity mark.
Traceability of outputs/events can neighbour detector-interop evidence — not Pact membership as compliance.
AI Pact voluntary governance pledges neighbour governance behavioural measurement — not notified-body status.
Prohibited-practice behavioural axis shares domain with AI Act enforcement machinery — domain expertise, not exposure claim.
Care axis can carry behavioural measures adjacent to early Pact transparency pledges — never Art.12 compliant.

disclaimer: IAW = measure/cite only. Crosswalk lists which GSPC axes are related measures for Art.12 record-keeping / AI Pact voluntary pledges. It is not a legal determination, conformity assessment, certification, or compliance claim.
